name: MikroTik RouterOS
description: RouterOS is MikroTik's network operating system, offering routing, firewalling, VPN and wireless management. The Cloud Hosted Router image runs as a VM.

notes.text: This VM imports a preinstalled MikroTik Cloud Hosted Router (CHR) disk image. No installer needs to be run.

For a fresh official CHR image, open the Proxmox console and log in as admin with an empty password (press Enter). Follow the first-login prompts and set a strong password immediately, or run /password in RouterOS.

Run /ip address print and /ip dhcp-client print in RouterOS to check the management IP and DHCP status. Use the configured IP in WinBox or WebFig; if no IP exists, configure networking through the console. Keep CHR on a trusted network until its password and firewall are configured. Factory credentials no longer apply after changing the password.
